texts.label: A
fehler: "leaving a little white paper on the skin" – unidiomatisch, besser "a scrap of white paper"
"His coat was buttoned incorrectly" – steif, "misbuttoned" wäre präziser
"halfway down the short row of benches" / "the bench across from him" – Raumlogik leicht unklar (eine Reihe, dann gegenüber)
"She knew the gesture from relatives who had been asked too many questions by too many people." – einziger erklärender Satz

texts.label: B
fehler: "I just wanted to see what you looked like when you weren't busy." – sentimental, nahe am Kitsch
"You sat with my mother. Room twelve. You did her hair." – Auflösung wird ausgesprochen, gegen den Geist der Vorgabe
"**Second Pew**" – Überschrift ist kein Szenentext
"like thread on a spool" – zusätzlicher Vergleich überfrachtet das Schlussbild
"Or was that someone else, some other winter." – Fragesatz ohne Fragezeichen, gewollt lyrisch

texts.label: C
fehler: "His hands rested flat on his knees" vs. "the pew where his hand had rested" – Logikbruch
"though it was ten feet too far for him to have read it anyway" – umständlich; er hat sich nie umgedreht
"though it hadn't rained since Tuesday" – Geister-Hinweis, abgegriffen
"searching for the geometry of someone she had intubated" – gesuchte Metapher
"a half-circle of condensation was already shrinking" – Gespenstertopos, Länge über 250 Wörter

texts.label: D
fehler: "The man's coat had a damp patch at the shoulder." – Gespensterandeutung, klischeenah
"Mara watched it spread beneath the pew, thin as a coin." – ein einzelner Tropfen breitet sich kaum so aus
"I thought I was." – bedeutungsschwer, leicht klischiert
"Beyond the chapel glass" / "In the glass" – Wiederholung, Raum unklar
"At 4:06" – Pseudopräzision

texts.label: E
fehler: "The tealight shivered in its plastic cup, though no air moved." – Batterielicht flackert ohnehin; übernatürlicher Wink, klischeenah
"which was the first wrong thing" – kein zweites "wrong thing" folgt
"the way she wore it after a patient's daughter had once looked her up online" – erklärender Einschub
"In eleven years she had learned that people at this hour usually supplied it unprompted" – erzählt statt zeigt
Länge deutlich über 250 Wörter
